name: real
_note: RQ3: six SWE-bench Verified tasks in a container, at four platform settings taken from official docs (2026-11-12): roomy = no limit (GitHub public runner is 4 vCPU / 16 GB, the whole VM); ci = 2 vCPU / 8 GB (GitHub private runner, GitLab small runner, Codespaces smallest); sandbox = 2 vCPU / 512 MiB (E2B default); pod = 1 vCPU / 512 MiB (Cloud Run default, Kubernetes LimitRange doc example). No platform documents a disk or process limit.
